featured_reviews.name: Dr Chirag Dalal
featured_reviews.review_text: Great location. No shade makes it difficult in the afternoons. Thinking what shall happen in the rains. Only 1 charger had qr code to scan. Other 2 seemed to be for fleet taxi as without the QR can't initiate charging.

featured_reviews.name: Shuvayu Mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Last update 8-Dec-2020: One CCS2 cable is made available for general public. Meaning, good for Nexon EV, Cona and SZ :-) thank you Tata Power!! 👍

All the chargers were working when I visited but there was no one to help. The CCS chaging plug went into the socket of my Nexon EV. The machine has a QR code (see the pic) but there is no mention of which app to use! It says to tap your RFID card. I tried my debit card. The machine did recognise it and the charger got locked into the car socket and the display showed time and KW but both were stuck at zero. The charging never started. I had to push the orange emergency stop button on the left side of the charger to unlock it!

There is no phone number mentioned. No name mentioned of the app to be used of the details of the RFID card. I reached home with 6% SOC with the AC turned off sweating in the humid heat.

UPDATE: I came to know after speaking with Tata Power EV charging specialist that this is their test facility and not available to general public. There is only one charger available for taxis Bharat DC001 (evarito and e2o type socket). CCS2 type (Cona, Nexon or ZS) will not be able to fast charge here.

featured_reviews.name: Heavenly Nature
featured_reviews.review_text: Easy to charge, convenient for them who travel using eastern express Highway. Just install Tata Power EZ charge App, recharge your account with sufficient balance and your are good to go stress free, even with an ev. The place is located exactly where an ev needs charging whether you are travelling towards South Mumbai from eastern suburbs or vice versa.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Mundada
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Tata power charging station

Location: excellent. Parking not an issue.

Charging: the EV charging experience was good.

Facilities: they have such a big power station but for their EV charging clients they don’t have a simple toilet.  Now even shade to sit along.

The only good thing is that their charging worked.

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Ahuja
featured_reviews.review_text: Only 1 CCS charger here which was not even working...No attendant which is needed for first time customer visits.. Tata needs to have some shame that it is charging Rs. 150 for every 15 mins of fast charging, ideally it is their duty to provide low lost charging facilities with much more number of working charging stations

featured_reviews.name: Utpal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Contact No is of Tata Power and not of EV charging Station. Pls update contact details

featured_reviews.name: Sundeep Amrutkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Most of the times it shows error and you will not be able to charge your Tata Nexon or Tigor here. There is also no attendant and Tata motors helpline is also helpless to solve these issue. Out of 4 times I visited here in a month Jan 2022 I did charge the vehicle only once and had to return 3 times .

featured_reviews.name: Srikanta Mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text: You need to understand which charger you car will support, ensure your car is on hand brake. Rest follow instructions on app, charging station screen and car dashboard. Smooth, self-help setup

featured_reviews.review_text:
IOCL EV Charging Station – Fort Motor, Goregaon East
Some charging stations come and go.
This one? It’s been around since ages, and that’s exactly why it earns trust.
Located at the IOCL Fort Motor petrol pump on the Western Express Highway service road, Goregaon East, this Tata Power–enabled EV charging station has been a dependable pit stop long before EV charging became fashionable.
📍 How to Reach (Important – Don’t Miss This)
This part matters more than people realise.
If you’re approaching from the highway, you must miss the Aarey flyover.
Do not go over it.
Take the service road under the flyover, and the petrol pump sits right there. Miss this turn and you’ll be doing an unnecessary U-turn tour of Goregaon.
🔌 Charging Experience
CCS-2 fast chargers available
Tariff is standard and transparent
Plug-in process is usually smooth
Over years of usage, this station has rarely disappointed
This has been one of those stations where you don’t hold your breath wondering “will it start or not?”it usually just works.
⏰ Late Night Advisory
Post 2 AM, expect EV taxis lining up.
This is a popular spot for fleet charging, so availability can suddenly drop.
Pro tip:
Always check the Tata Power EZ Charge app before heading here, especially late night. It’ll save you time and irritation.
🧾 Final Take
This is not a flashy mall charger or a café-side setup.
It’s a workhorsereliable, familiar, and time-tested.
If you know how to reach it and plan your timing right, this station continues to be one of Goregaon East’s most dependable EV charging options.
⭐ Consistent. Reliable. Old-school dependable.
Exactly what you want when your battery bar is blinking.
— SGT Reviews
Sip. Grab. Taste. ⚡
